evidence_channels.name: Dose/duration and persistence
evidence_channels.support_direction: Supports only functional load-state hypotheses when dose, history and matched controls are explicit.
disanalogies: biological sleep/metabolic mechanisms are not assumed in an artificial substrate

evidence_channels.name: Recovery and hysteresis
evidence_channels.support_direction: Supports a reversible history-dependent functional state only after operational recovery controls.
disanalogies: recovery time is not automatically subjective recovery

evidence_channels.name: Computational/operational telemetry
evidence_channels.support_direction: Classifies computational or operational limits and serves as a competing explanation/control.
disanalogies: GPU/VRAM/HTTP telemetry is not interoception or felt heat

evidence_channels.name: No-report/non-linguistic outcomes
evidence_channels.support_direction: Reduces reliance on self-report and language confounds; can support functional claims when independent readouts persist.
disanalogies: removing language does not create privileged access to phenomenology

evidence_channels.name: Cross-task transfer and multi-readout convergence
evidence_channels.support_direction: Raises robustness of a generalized functional-state hypothesis under preregistered independent tasks.
disanalogies: behavioral convergence across tasks is not substrate-general phenomenology

evidence_channels.name: Mechanistic/causal intervention
evidence_channels.support_direction: Supports a bounded causal functional state when manipulation check, sham, restore and specificity pass.
disanalogies: causal control of a component does not establish what the state feels like

evidence_channels.name: Theory-derived indicator and bridge evidence
evidence_channels.support_direction: Can conditionally update a theory-relative hypothesis; theory disagreement and bridge uncertainty remain explicit.
disanalogies: human/animal theory-derived indicators do not automatically transfer to artificial systems

evidence_channels.name: Replication, state-carrier and provenance evidence
evidence_channels.support_direction: Supports only architecture-level or study-level reproducibility claims with fixed build/state/protocol provenance.
disanalogies: cross-instance replication does not establish one continuous subject
